reviews.text:
Dr. Coureau took care of my dog ​​in the 8th arrondissement until she passed away two years ago.

I just adopted a dog named Blue, but Dr. Coureau moved to Redon 😪
He's such a great vet that I go to his clinic in Redon even though it's an hour away by public transport.

I highly recommend him. 🫶
I don't know Dr. Awad yet, but I have no doubt he's also a very good vet.

And the reception staff are fantastic, attentive, and helpful; they're super friendly.

Very good veterinary clinic.
More than reasonable prices. ⭐️⭐️⭐️

An absolutely wonderful team, from Dr. Awad to the veterinary assistants. ❤️

We were particularly touched by their kindness, humanity, and compassion. Dr. Awad was extremely available, responsive, and attentive, and you can truly feel that he practices his profession with passion, commitment, and a genuine concern for animal welfare.

The veterinary assistants are also incredibly kind and always very caring, which is especially reassuring when you're worried about your pet.

A huge thank you to the entire team for your professionalism, your availability, and above all, for all the attention you give to our animals. We can tell that their well-being is truly your top priority. I recommend them without hesitation! ❤️

Hello to the whole team 😁
Bonbon, Guizmo, and Cash thank you for the kindness, care, and gentleness you've shown them 🙏🏻
Thank you for listening and for the time you spent with me 😁
I had questions and doubts about my ability to raise my cats and my favorite kittens, and you reassured me.

A big THANK YOU 🙏🏻💖
You should be receiving some of Bonbon's kittens in a few months 😁

And we'll see you later for checkups 🫡😁
Very professional,...

Dr. Coureau and Dr. Awad are much more than excellent veterinarians; they are trustworthy, dedicated individuals deeply committed to animal welfare. We thank them immensely for everything they do for Popeye and for the remarkable quality of their care. We recommend them without hesitation.
Fantastic veterinary clinic! Doctors Awad and Coureau truly love and are passionate about animals! Thank you for taking such good care of our four-legged friends!
After bad experiences with other vets in the area, it was a relief to find a team that listened. Highly recommended practice.

First visit, very disappointing. I asked for a worming pipette for a 3-5 kg ​​cat... when I got home I realized they'd sold me the 5-8 kg one. Plus, the credit card terminal wasn't working. 😡 So I don't think I'll be going back. …
I received a very warm welcome and the vet was attentive.

Thank you to Dr. Awad for her kindness, compassion, and professionalism every time I brought my cat, Maurice, in.

Thank you also for your gentleness and support during his final days; it helped me immensely through this difficult time. Thank you as well to the team I interacted with, who were always pleasant and helpful.
Dr. Coureau is an exceptional veterinarian! He always provides prompt care despite his busy schedule, and takes excellent care of our four-legged companions! I highly recommend him.
Oh Leopold, what a handsome guy 😻 and so kind! Thank you for giving us 5 stars ⭐️ …

5 stars isn't enough to describe this clinic. The kind and pretty blonde lady at reception is incredibly kind and caring. I thank the entire team for their warm welcome and kindness, and for the gift too. I will definitely recommend it to my friends and family. ❤️
They were so kind and attentive to Luna, thank you so much!

Vet available very quickly for an emergency.
Our cat wasn't doing well (fluid in his lungs).
He took care of him and asked us to keep him updated. Our only call was to tell him he was doing great.
Thank you, De Coureau!

Thank you to Dr. Awad and his entire team, who were exceptional in all their services. I'm sad to be leaving Marseille and no longer have you as my veterinarian.

You are kind, attentive, and offer excellent advice.
Thank you again!
I highly recommend your practice.
Thank you to the whole team for your quick response and advice. Wally is doing much better thanks to your charcoal kit and his new kibble. 🙏🫶🏼 …

A huge thank you to Dr. Awad and her assistant who saw me last night with Miss Cat, a very sick 17-year-old senior cat whom I took in after the passing of our father-in-law. They received us with tremendous care, kindness, and compassion. Thank you to Dr. Awad for her gentle and professional treatment. Thank you to her assistant, whose name I unfortunately didn't catch, for her warm welcome. A visit that healed both body and soul.
Excellent welcome, attentive and very competent, I highly recommend this clinic, it's top-notch.
Very happy with this veterinary practice, I will have my dog ​​treated there.

Hello, I highly recommend Dr. Coureau's veterinary clinic. He is a very good doctor—attentive, patient, calm, and a good listener—and he has a very good team of veterinary assistants. I will always remain a loyal customer of this clinic whenever possible, depending on their schedule. I highly recommend them.

Thank you to Dr. AWAD and his entire team, who welcomed us and our litter of 8 puppies. They were professional, attentive, gentle, patient, and their prices were very competitive. They were incredibly kind! I highly recommend them; go without hesitation!
Thank you for the 5 stars 😃 …
The vet is approachable, kind, and open to discussion; I will continue to come here for my cat.

The veterinarians are attentive and take excellent care of their patients. The team is wonderful and always welcoming. I've seen several vets in Mazargues (at the old location), and these are the best. Your animals aren't treated like cash cows. You can go there with complete confidence.

Delighted with Dr. Awad's professionalism.
Our dog Vecchio was operated on by this doctor who, in addition to his expertise, is gentle and sensitive towards his patients and their owners.

Dr. Coureau remains the best vet in my neighborhood, and I'm sure he's the best in all of Marseille! He's passionate, gentle, and down-to-earth, and I have complete trust in him! Regarding the "reception," as I read in a negative review, that's simply not true; it's exemplary, and the receptionists are exceptional both in person and on the phone! A fantastic team, thank you! (For Tango the cocker spaniel 🙃)
From the moment I arrived until the consultation, it was absolutely perfect! Friendly, attentive, professional, and gentle with the animal. I'm delighted!
Veterinarians Dr. Coureau and Dr. Awad are fantastic; they truly love animals and are very attentive. I highly recommend this veterinary clinic; I love it!
The appointment was on time, and Dr. Coureau is gentle with the animals, taking the time to see us and answer our questions.
friendly staff

A truly humane clinic with exceptional professionalism. You feel confident and, above all, they listen attentively to your dog. I lost my Pastaga two years ago, and Dr. Coureau, deeply moved, took the time to call me to explain and offer support during my grief. The entire team, in fact, provided me with comfort. Today, he is also caring for my new companion, Pirlouit, and I am delighted.
Thank you for your feedback!

As usual, it's a pleasure for my babies to come. I'm so happy to have met Dr. Awad, who is just as wonderful and kind as Dr. Courreau and Dr. Lognon, the veterinary assistants as well. I come from far away and I will continue to come; the animals are truly loved! Thank you for being Kimbo and Hulk's licker.
Always on time and offers good advice

For the past 14 years, my little dog has been a patient of Dr. Coureau. Always available, even in emergencies, and very professional, my little dog trusts him completely. His kindness reassures him, and me too 😉 I wouldn't change vets for anything. Thank you, Doctor, for the wonderful way you practice this profession. …

The quality of listening, advice, care, and reception is consistently maintained, even in emergency situations, by the entire team at this clinic, exemplified by Dr. C, who knows how to surround himself with the right people. Bravo and thank you! My three animals are in perfect health thanks to your professionalism and compassion. 🤝🙏
A warm welcome from an experienced and professional team. Our companions are the beneficiaries of their expertise. Thank you.
A very warm welcome. Parking isn't easy, but it's worth the effort: the doctor is attentive and truly cares about our animals (cats in my case).
Thank you for the 5 stars! We hope Paco is doing well :-)
